title: Quantitative evaluation of sense of discrepancy to operation response using event-related potential
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a quantitative method to evaluate the human 'sense of discrepancy' to product operation responses using neuroscience techniques (event-related potential, P300). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The mention of 'Ethics Committee' approval is a standard procedural requirement for human participant studies, not the subject of the research itself.
